listing.name: Ratchet & Clank — OpenRatchet (Nikityyy)
listing.summary: The native app replaces platform services but retains PS2Recomp’s fallback game executor. Level 0, rendering and overlay checks do not establish complete gameplay. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PlayStation 2 ISO. This guide does not specify the required version or serial number; check the project’s source manifest before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow this project’s local extraction, Ghidra, recompilation and build instructions using privately supplied assets. This implementation is independent of the OpenRAC C-decompilation runtime.

warnings: The native app replaces platform services but retains PS2Recomp’s fallback game executor. Level 0, rendering and overlay checks do not establish complete gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
